program: F124-E scientific key-value binding; independent of FORGE autonomy F124/F125
baseline_negative: F124-D actual 100-epoch TRAIN A/B: Wingless 0/48 each, Yggdrasil 1/48 each, versus fixed public raw Hamming 41/48 in both; F124-C also negative (0/48). Competitive per-node mass conservation and two slots did not yield causal binding. No retrospective retuning.
hypothesis: Explicit learned addressable key→value memory records at graph merge points, preserving each carried raw token identity until it is selectively queried by an outgoing edge, will avoid causal relation-splicing that defeated aggregated per-node state and show new-structure transfer.

mechanism.A: 3-slot per-node learned associative memory. Each record retains a differentiable key derived from incoming destination token and learned value/hop state; a query derived from outgoing source token performs learned key compatibility, independent of node path enumeration. Trainable key encoder + address scoring + learned value transport and calibrated binary head. Repeated-key collisions and wrong-query crossovers explicitly tested.
mechanism.B: Same public input and 3-record memory bound, but competitive independent key assignment with differentiable slot-overlap penalty and controlled eviction of least confident record. Identity of key and carried value must remain paired; no unstructured mean-state pooling.
mechanism.budget: <=768 trainable parameters, <=3 key-value slots per node, 100 epochs fixed, 16 raw token bits and 8 latent dimensions, <=128 messages per hop, <=64 nodes, <=128 edges. No adding slots after results.
mechanism.objective: Frozen balanced 0.5 positive/negative BCE + paired ranking softplus; fixed decision at probability >=0.5; no posthoc threshold selection; 4 balanced TRAIN pairs per epoch. B adds constant 0.03 overlap term; train-only A/B selector paired accuracy with tie A.

source.public_graph_schema: {start,target,roles,edges:[{from,to,role,src_bits:[16],dst_bits:[16]}]}; exact strict input whitelist. No source ID, route selection, truth or equality flags to model.
source.design: TRAIN 4–5 hops; reserved CONFIRM 7–9 hops; new independent salt, two key-distinct branch sources reconverge, plus key/value spoof routes, near-equality bit aliases, repeated values on wrong roles, and parallel edges. Select necessity of key→value pairing at at least one shared internal junction.
source.negative: Swap a causally necessary raw src_bits token with an off-role source-slot token, preserving per-pair source/role/node topology, multiset of all raw slot bitstrings, degree, exact edge count and path-role sequence.
source.admission: Independent public symbolic traversal verifies exactly one positive consistent start→target route and zero negative consistent routes. Positive vs negative have >=3 role-compatible structural routes; collision strata cover branch/source confusion. Quarantine ambiguous witnesses and accidental structural leakage.
source.anti_shortcut: Each pair has exactly equal source-target and query role identities, degrees, graph edge counts and global token histograms. Edge ordering randomized; topology-only, role-only, depth-only, histogram-only and masked-token classifier controls must not distinguish labels. Audit any candidate observable source shortcut before inference.

cohorts.lane_vectors: Reuse only authenticated frozen F123 source TRAIN candidate vectors and candidate SHA IDs, bound to immutable SHA-256 12da879272212b899c6b942004ff38dc21ffa6bb20e7a81eac21d691746b474d; no FORGE/CKB external ingestion.
cohorts.labels: Strictly paired balanced positives and negatives with same public non-slot features.
cohorts.prohibited_read: Never generate, inspect or tune on CONFIRM before a separately witnessed exact-head original first-use.

controls.baseline_F124D: Immutable TRAIN negative only. No retroactive retuning. F124-D CONFIRM remains closed.
controls.fixed_12_of_16: 12/16 raw-bit Hamming public traversal; declared approximate and count operations.
controls.topology_only: 20-feature query, degree and role learner without raw token bits, same 100 epochs.
controls.token_histogram_only: Raw token multiset without edge assignment.
controls.exact_symbolic_ceiling: Exact public equality traversal; separate computational upper bound excluded from +5%-point baseline.

qualification.training_check: Actual finite nonzero updates, single frozen selector, numerically checked gradients, source-birth identity, no privileged features or protected seed access.
qualification.primary: True paired accuracy and balanced accuracy separately on independent 7–9-hop reserved confirmation in both scientific lanes, only after original first-use authorization.
qualification.development_threshold: At least +0.05 paired accuracy in BOTH lanes over strongest eligible equal-input resource-matched heuristic, no near-collision/alias/repeated-key stratum harm, causal key retrieval ablation stronger than distractor, no ignored negatives.
qualification.ablation: After predictions, remove unique causal join edge versus each distractor edge, swap key/value identities independently, vary branch order and trace rank of retrieved key. No path IDs given to model.
qualification.compute: For all arms and controls, count public edge scans, raw-bit comparisons, multiplies/adds, sigmoid/exponent, peak key-value slots/live messages, weight count, serialized bytes. Different primitive costs => resource superiority NOT_ESTABLISHED, do not claim equality.
qualification.preservation: Frozen SHA 40-bit Git blob and exact branch source, frozen TRAIN vector receipts, complete weight and negative evidence, SHA-256 artifacts, original first use independent; draft-only engineering changes.
